hints.title: Bottom-Up Path Balance
hints.text: For any node with two children, their branch sums down to the leaves must be identical to equalize total root-to-leaf path sums.

hints.title: Sibling Cost Difference
hints.text: To equalize siblings with minimal cost, always increment the smaller child's cost to match the larger child's cost.

hints.title: Bottom-Up Propagation
hints.text: Iterate from internal parents n // 2 down to 1, accumulating abs(cost[left] - cost[right]) and adding max(cost[left], cost[right]) to parent.

hints.title: Bottom-Up Greedy Equalization Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minIncrements(self, n: int, cost: list[int]) -> int:
        ans = 0
        for i in range(n // 2 - 1, -1, -1):
            left = 2 * i + 1
            right = 2 * i + 2
            ans += abs(cost[left] - cost[right])
            cost[i] += max(cost[left], cost[right])
        return ans
```

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Bottom-up traversal of array-represented complete binary tree.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all paths independently ignores common ancestor subproblems.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space modifying cost array in place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that balancing leaves bottom-up preserves optimal global cost.
